method: Actual 18 gallery DOM clicks -> native main IPC / behavior -> actual renderer draw and paint, using wall-clock playback; test diagnostics only expose state, disable external idle probes and arm an already-due walk.

preview.note: Grid combines each actual button playback from its own start, holding its final idle after completion; individual recordings retain observed pose timing.

manualVisualReview.method: Visual inspection of all 18 actual-renderer contact sheets and all 18 adjacent-interruption contact sheets. Rechecked final rest/curl routes and the sleep-to-rest-to-walk recording after removing deep-crouch frame 2. Animated WebP assets preserve actual observed pose timing; the 18-panel overview holds completed clips at their final idle.
findings: All 18 buttons display their intended distinct action and end at the shared idle. Feeding reaches for a token, lifts it to the mouth, chews, lowers the hand and returns to idle with the same round head, outfit and proportions.

Sneak bends and reaches down, while token-game holds a puzzle paper and tastes a token. Neither recording shows overall character enlargement relative to idle or feeding; the bent posture changes body height naturally.

Rest and curl now enter through 0 -> 1 -> 3 and rise through 3 -> 1 -> 0. The former deep-crouch-then-head-rise reversal is absent. Rest is seated dozing; curl visibly hugs the knees, so they no longer duplicate a generic sleep action.

Review raises and lowers a page; stretch raises arms overhead; wave lowers its hand before switching. Adjacent interruptions visibly complete their recovery to shared idle before starting the next action.

No blank drawing, cropped head or foot, ghost blend, face stretch or nonuniform body scaling was found in the inspected sequences. The main renderer uses one opaque complete authored sprite per drawing, with exact pixel comparison against the same complete-frame reference.
Hair remains in the same blue family across the new feeding and expression poses. Highlights and tips retain pose-dependent shading. Tail color and silhouette vary with the intended tail orientation.
boundaries: This is authored pose animation: visible changes between distinct drawings remain, especially for the large jump and opposite tail positions; no claim of continuous newly drawn motion at display refresh rate.
The older apology recovery drawings retain slight face-outline differences. They were not visibly enlarged and did not reveal a new transition-order regression in these recordings.
The 18 ring-adjacent interruptions cover every gallery action as a source and destination, not every possible ordered pair of 18 actions.
